summary: A concise DM-facing summary of the adventure.
playerSafeSummary: A spoiler-safe hook or pitch suitable for the player packet.
startingHook: The party is hired to investigate a ruined keep where lights have been seen after sunset.

campaignSetup.suggestedSessionZeroNotes: Discuss horror tone, lines/veils, and character ties to Ravensford.

chapters.name: Chapter 1: Arrival in Ravensford
chapters.summary: The party arrives, gathers rumours, and learns about the haunted keep.
chapters.readAloud: Rain slicks the cobbles of Ravensford as the old keep watches from the hill above.
chapters.dmNotes: Keep the first session focused on tone, rumours, and one short danger beat.

scenes.name: Rumours at the Lantern & Thorn
scenes.summary: The characters can gather rumours, meet Mara, and hear the first warning about the keep.
scenes.readAloud: The inn smells of wet wool, woodsmoke, and spiced cider. Conversation fades as strangers enter.
scenes.boxedText: Optional boxed text can live here if you use it.
scenes.dmNotes: Mara is helpful but frightened. She avoids naming the old chapel directly.

locations.name: Ravensford
locations.summary: A rain-soaked village below the ruined keep.

locations.name: The Lantern & Thorn
locations.summary: Warm, cramped, and full of worried locals.

maps.name: Ravensford Region Map
maps.summary: A regional map showing Ravensford, the old keep, the river road, and nearby woods.

maps.name: Old Keep Ground Floor
maps.summary: Ground floor of the ruined keep.

npcs.name: Mara Vell
npcs.summary: A practical innkeeper who knows more local history than she admits.

creatures.name: Ash Wight
creatures.summary: An undead guardian bound to the old shrine below the keep.

factions.name: The Grey Watch
factions.summary: A thinly-stretched local guard force trying to keep order.
factions.goals: Keep villagers alive; avoid panic; find missing scouts.

quests.name: Investigate the Old Keep
quests.summary: Discover what has awakened in the ruined keep.
quests.reward: 150 gp, local favour, one uncommon magic item

encounters.name: Bandits on the River Road
encounters.summary: Desperate bandits ambush travellers before the party reaches Ravensford.
encounters.tactics: The bandits flee if reduced to half their number.
encounters.treasure: 2d6 sp, a crude map to Ravensford

secrets.name: The Keep Was Built Over a Shrine
secrets.summary: The old keep was built on top of a sealed shrine to a forgotten power.
secrets.revealTrigger: Research, old songs, chapel frescoes, or Mara's confession.

handouts.name: Mara's Old Song
handouts.summary: A nursery rhyme that hints at the shrine beneath the keep.
handouts.playerText: Under stone and under rain, the hollow king forgets his name.

treasure.name: Chapel Cache
treasure.summary: A hidden coffer behind loose chapel stones.

entries.result: Lights move in the keep after midnight.
Mara knows an old song about the hill.

rules.name: Haunted Ground
rules.summary: While inside the keep after midnight, Wisdom saving throws against fear are made with disadvantage unless a character carries a blessed light.
